text:
marta: Quick kick 3 680 We have a UK/EU-focused launch on May 20. Need a benchmark-led creative pack + a short sales-ready slide deck. Deliverables: hero (web), 4 social tiles, 1 infographic slide (methodology + topline), 2 deck templates (sales + webinar), and a compliance check. Deadline: 48h.

leo: I'll own creative. Clarify: benchmark narrative (do we want a claims-heavy slide with numbers or a high-level qualitative story?). Also, do we need regional copy (EN-UK) or just EN?

marta: Keep it conservative: topline numbers ok if footnoted with test conditions. Use EN-UK spelling. Also request a UK-specific hero copy variant and two headline options for A/B.

anya: I'll draft headlines and the short methodology blurb. Need the benchmark source files for footnotes (ML team, please post). Also we need three social copy lengths for each tile.

designbot: Specs/exports checklist:
- Hero: 1920x1080 + 1200x628 (preview)
- Social tiles: 1080x1080 (square), 1200x630 (link), 1080x1350 (tall), 800x800 (partner co-post)
- Infographic slide: 1920x1080 PNG + layered Figma source
- Deck templates: 16:9 PPTX + 4:5 for social repurpose
- Fonts: Inter (include fallback note), SVG logos, alt-text file for every asset
- Accessibility: provide one high-contrast colorway (WCAG AA for body, AAA for CTA if feasible)
- Motion: 6s GIF/WebM teaser (800x450) optional

leo: File naming: LAUNCH_UK_<asset>_<locale>_v1.png. Add README with final sizes and export settings. I'll add a partner co-brand lockup as optional layer.

ops: Lead routing rules for registration form:
- country in [GB,IE] -> assign queue_eu_uk_sales
- EU countries -> queue_emea_marketing
- US/CA -> queue_namer_marketing
Add fields: lead.is_uk_launch = true, lead.language = "en-UK" when locale detected. Capture timezone_pref and utm params.

marta: UTM: utm_source=social, utm_medium=organic, utm_campaign=launch-uk-may20. Primary CTA: "Reserve your spot". Add alt CTA for partner co-post: "Learn how we measured it".

legal: Quick notes: any numeric claims need test conditions footnoted (date, model, seq length). Avoid superlatives like "fastest" without evidence. For EU data capture, ensure consent checkbox text meets GDPR standards; send approved wording and we'll sign off ASAP.

anya: I'll loop legal on the methodology blurb and provide the three headline variants here by EOD.

leo: Design Q: do we want infographic to include a tiny methodology timeline (3 bullets) or a 1-paragraph CTA to the docs? Timeline's better for social readability but uses space.

marta: Go timeline (3 bullets) + tiny link to docs footer. Add a CTA overlay in lower third for replay assets.

designbot: Uploaded project to Figma (dev): https://figma.com/file/uklaunch/benchmark-pack. Initial exports named: LAUNCH_UK_HERO_EN-UK.png, LAUNCH_UK_INFOGRAPHIC_EN-UK.png, LAUNCH_UK_SOC_1080_EN-UK.png. README added.

ops: Reminder: map utm_campaign to attribution.campaign_name = "launch_uk_may20" in CRM on webhook ingestion. Also set lead.source_detail = "benchmark_uk_social" when social cookie present.

legal: I'll post GDPR-approved consent text here in 2 hours. Also require that partner logos are provided with trademark usage terms before co-branding.

leo: Will push first-pass PNGs in ~7h and include alt text and color-contrast notes.

marta: Thanks team 4aa3fb Once assets are live I'll do a quick CRO test on the micro-form and sanity-check UTM mapping.
